component.name: Cosmos Weather
component.summary: MET Norway forecasts for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: An independent Cosmos family weather application for the COSMIC desktop with current conditions, hourly temperature charts, and daily forecasts from MET Norway, the meteorological service behind Yr.

Choose and save locations explicitly. Forecast requests share a private cache and conservative request limits with Cosmos Date & Time. No account, automatic location detection, or telemetry is required.
